gameChannels.name: 🐛・bug-reports
gameChannels.topic: Choose the severity that best fits your report. Describe what happened, what you expected, and steps to reproduce it. Include screenshots, video or F9 console errors where useful. Owners mark reports Fixed or Closed.

gameChannels.name: 💡・feature-suggestions
gameChannels.topic: Share one suggestion per post. Explain how it would improve the game and check for similar suggestions first. Owners mark completed suggestions Implemented.

gameChannels.name: 🛠️・dev-discussions
gameChannels.topic: Owners start discussions about development, balancing and progression. Everyone is welcome to reply and share constructive feedback.

onboarding.notificationsQuestion: Which pings / notifications would you like?

rules: Follow Discord and Roblox terms at all times.
Treat everyone respectfully. Harassment, hate speech, or targeted abuse is not allowed. Ordinary swearing and friendly banter are fine.
Do not spam, flood channels, or deliberately disrupt conversations.
Keep content appropriate for the server and the channel you are using.
Do not share private or personal information without permission.
Do not post scams, malware, phishing, exploits, or other harmful material.
Use channels for their intended purpose and stay reasonably on topic.
Do not repeatedly ping staff or members without a valid reason.
Behave respectfully in voice chat and do not troll, mic spam, or harass others.
Respect staff decisions and raise concerns calmly through help.
